title: Layering first person stuff and animating it is such low effort for great results!
author: RealAstropulse
selftext: This was so much fun to make, just generated some first person perspective images (car interior, arm with the wheel, other hand) and slapped it on top of some fpv drone footage. I really want to play a game like this now lol

comments.author: Col2k
comments.body:
thank you for the inspiration

with hobby gamedev work while pressed for time with life shit, I struggled to go from pong to dream game. This looks like a fun middle ground project to just create something.

Bless you, have a nice weekend
